content.title: Announcing the First-Ever Arvada Summerfest on June 7
content.summary: Arvada, Colorado, will host its inaugural Summerfest on June 7, 2025, at Ralston Park Addition from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. This free event combines elements from the former Arvada on Tap and Arvada Days, featuring live music, activities for all ages, a pet swimsuit competition, and local food vendors, while also supporting community service organizations.
content.body:
## Celebrate the Start of Summer at the First-Ever Arvada Summerfest

**May 14, 2025**

Arvada, Colorado – Get ready to kick off the season in style! The City of Arvada and the Arvada Festivals Commission are proud to introduce Arvada Summerfest, a brand-new event for 2025 that brings together the best of two former events — Arvada on Tap and Arvada Days — into one unforgettable summer celebration.

Join us on Saturday, June 7, from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Ralston Park Addition (64th Avenue and Quail Street, just north of Arvada West High School) for this free, family- and pet-friendly event packed with music, fun, food and community spirit.

### What to expect at Arvada Summerfest:

- A full lineup of live music from local bands featuring the headliner, Arvada-based country-rock quartet, The Barlow, with support from Earl Nelson & the Company, and Mighty Holler
- Activities for all ages, including a free kids zone with inflatables
- Pet swimsuit competition and parade (register the day of at the event)
- Fundraising for our community service organization partners: Arvada Jefferson Kiwanis Club, Arvada Sunrise Rotary, and Arvada Vitality Alliance
- Beer garden throughout the entire event grounds
- Tasty treats from local favorites like Power Cone soft serve ice cream, Fanwhich sandwiches, Beltran’s authentic Mexican street tacos, and more!

“We’re thrilled to launch Arvada Summerfest as a new summer tradition that brings our community together in a fun and meaningful way,” said Adelle Burton, Arvada’s Special Events Manager. “With great music, great food, and great causes, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.”

For more details, visit [arvadaco.gov/summerfest](//arvadaco.gov/summerfest).
